stories.title: Muse Glimmer from Meta Superintelligence Labs is now available
stories.author: unknown
bullet_points: Meta has released Muse Glimmer, its first open model from Meta Superintelligence Labs.
Muse Glimmer is a 30B multimodal model released under the permissive Apache 2.0 license.
The model is specifically designed for local coding agents and is optimized via Ollama's MLX engine with new DFlash and image input support.

stories.title: 🤗 Trending: deepseek-ai/DeepSeek-R1
stories.author: unknown
bullet_points: Highlights a trending model, DeepSeek-R1, on Hugging Face Benchmarks.
The model is categorized for text generation and conversational AI tasks.
It utilizes standard ML components like transformers and safetensors.

stories.title: 🤗 Trending: meta-llama/Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct
stories.author: unknown
bullet_points: The news highlights the trending status of the Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct model on Hugging Face.
It pertains to the text-generation pipeline, indicating its use in large language model applications.
The model is associated with key technologies like transformers and safetensors, relevant to the ML community.

stories.title: 🤗 Trending: meta-llama/Meta-Llama-3-8B
stories.author: unknown
bullet_points: The news highlights the trending status of the Meta-Llama-3-8B model on Hugging Face Benchmarks.
The model is categorized under text-generation pipelines, indicating its primary function.
Key associated technologies include transformers and safetensors, standard in modern NLP.

stories.title: NVIDIA Nemotron 3.5 Lightning
stories.author: unknown
bullet_points: NVIDIA Nemotron 3.5 Lightning is now accessible via Ollama.
It is a 30 billion parameter open model optimized for persistent AI agents.
The model is designed for complex, multi-step tasks requiring context gathering and tool calling on local hardware.

stories.title: Ollama: all aboard open models
stories.author: unknown
bullet_points: Ollama, a platform for running open models, has secured significant funding.
The company raised $88 million from prominent investors including Y Combinator and Benchmark.
Ollama currently serves a large developer base of 8.9 million users.

stories.title: Faster Gemma 4 on MLX with multi-token prediction
stories.author: unknown
bullet_points: Gemma 4 inference speed is significantly improved in Ollama 0.31 on Apple Silicon.
The performance boost is achieved through Multi-Token Prediction (MTP) powered by MLX.
Coding agent performance saw up to 90% speed increase when tested with the Aider polyglot benchmark.

stories.title: Ollama's highest performance on Apple Silicon yet with MLX
stories.author: unknown
bullet_points: Ollama has achieved its peak performance on Apple Silicon using the MLX engine.
The performance improvements result in faster response times and lower memory usage for models.
The updated engine also enables models to generate higher quality outputs.

stories.title: NVIDIA Nemotron 3 Ultra
stories.author: unknown
bullet_points: Introduction of NVIDIA Nemotron 3 Ultra, a new AI model.
The model is specifically engineered for high-throughput reasoning tasks.
It is designed to support complex, long-running agent workflows.

stories.title: Russian drones strike Ukraine’s data centers by exploiting air defense gaps
stories.author: Jeremy Hsu
bullet_points: Russian military operations are targeting critical Ukrainian infrastructure, specifically data centers.
The attacks exploit vulnerabilities in Ukraine's air defense systems.
The disruption of internet and phone services poses a significant threat to Ukraine's wartime economy.

stories.title: Base Models Can Reason By Taking a Cue From Training Data
stories.author: Alexei A. Efros
bullet_points: Base language models can exhibit reasoning capabilities simply by being prompted with specific starting tokens from their training data.
Fixing certain 'cue' tokens significantly boosts performance on complex tasks like math and coding, rivaling RL-tuned models.
The research highlights that the structure and associations within the training data dictate emergent reasoning behaviors in foundational models.

stories.title: Recursive Video In-Context Learning for Agentic Robot
stories.author: Yuzhang Shang
bullet_points: Introduces 'Recursive Video' to improve LLM agents that orchestrate frozen VLA policies.
Addresses limitations of current methods where full demonstration videos are too slow or lose critical contact details in fixed keyframes.
The technique aims to enhance agent performance by improving how text memory interacts with visual context during task execution.

stories.title: Base Models Can Reason By Taking a Cue From Training Data
stories.author: Alexei A. Efros
bullet_points: Base language models can exhibit reasoning capabilities simply by being given specific starting token cues.
Fixing these initial cues can significantly boost performance on complex tasks like math and coding, rivaling RL-trained models.
The research demonstrates that training data implicitly encodes associations between prompt structure and subsequent reasoning behavior.

stories.title: Towards Looped Models Done Right, Part II: Rethinking at Fixed Points
stories.author: Xuezhe Ma
bullet_points: Proposes a method ('Rethinking at Fixed Points') to optimize looped language models by leveraging the convergence of recurrent states.
Enables significant efficiency gains, including truncated backpropagation in training and terminal KV sharing in decoding.
Achieves substantial speedups in downstream tasks, such as faster prefilling (1.79x) and faster RL updates (2x).

stories.title: T-Search: An Open Agentic Retriever and Playground for Hard Multi-Step Search
stories.author: Anatolii Potapov
bullet_points: T-Search is an open-weight agentic retriever designed specifically for complex, multi-step search queries.
It performs bounded, multi-round search over a fixed corpus, providing ranked evidence chunks with justifications.
The architecture allows for decoupling the search backend from the final answer generation model, enabling modularity.

stories.title: Ollama now supports Jev-style decision models
stories.author: unknown
bullet_points: Ollama has integrated support for Jev-style decision models via TypeSafe's Jev API.
These new models enable fast, low-latency, and cost-free execution of typed decisions.
The models can process text to provide probabilistic answers for yes/no questions, choices, and scores.

stories.title: Claude Desktop support with Ollama
stories.author: unknown
bullet_points: Claude Desktop now supports Ollama as a third-party gateway.
This integration allows users to run open-source models within the Claude Desktop environment.
It bridges proprietary LLM interfaces with local, open-weight model ecosystems.

stories.title: Improved performance and model support with GGUF
stories.author: unknown
bullet_points: Ollama 0.30 release brings performance improvements and enhanced GGUF model compatibility.
The update leverages llama.cpp to broaden model support across various hardware platforms.
It augments Ollama's MLX engine, particularly benefiting users on Apple silicon.

stories.title: Gemini Call for Me might tell your mom you’re running late
stories.author: Stevie Bonifield
bullet_points: Google is reportedly expanding its 'Call for Me' AI feature beyond professional use.
The feature, dubbed 'Gemini Calling,' allows users to send conversational messages via voice calls.
Early examples suggest it can be used for personal updates, such as notifying family about delays.

stories.title: Reverse-engineered games: All the news on video game decomps, recomps, VR and web and 3D ports
stories.author: Verge Staff
bullet_points: Decompilation and recompilation are enabling retro games to be freed from original proprietary code and hardware.
This process allows classic titles to be ported to new devices or significantly modified.
The trend is expanding into modern applications, such as porting games to VR and web platforms.

stories.title: This startup is issuing AI-generated acne prescriptions
stories.author: Emma Roth
bullet_points: Healthcare startup Nolla Health is launching an AI-driven service for acne treatment in Utah.
Users can scan their faces via the app, allowing an AI system to analyze acne severity.
The AI system autonomously generates prescriptions for acne treatment.

stories.title: MCP for agent-to-agent comms may be the riskiest protocol you've never heard of
stories.author: Dan Goodin
bullet_points: A new protocol, MCP, is being discussed for agent-to-agent communication.
The protocol introduces significant security risks due to trust gaps.
These gaps allow for the propagation of malicious prompts between AI agents.

stories.title: Command-line tool quickly removes Apple Intelligence from macOS 27
stories.author: Scharon Harding
bullet_points: A command-line tool is available to remove Apple Intelligence features from macOS 27.
The removal process can reclaim a substantial amount of storage, exceeding 12GB.
This suggests user control and potential bloat concerns regarding new OS features.

stories.title: Controlling the brain with light earns a physiology Nobel
stories.author: John Timmer
bullet_points: The news reports a Nobel Prize in Physiology for advancements in optogenetics.
Optogenetics is a technique that uses light to control biological processes, tracing its origins to light-seeking algae.
This represents a significant scientific achievement in neuroscience and biotechnology.

stories.title: AI glasses face their first major government crackdown
stories.author: Richard Milne, Financial Times
bullet_points: Norway is addressing the regulatory challenges posed by AI-enabled glasses.
The focus of the crackdown is on the recording capabilities of these devices concerning bystanders.
The government is seeking time to establish permanent legal frameworks for this emerging technology.

stories.title: One Figure, Every Canvas: Editable Flowchart Relayout via Agentic Pipeline
stories.author: Yu-Lun Liu
bullet_points: Addresses the practical problem of adapting complex ML flowchart diagrams to various aspect ratios (e.g., paper, slides, social media).
Proposes an 'aspect-ratio-adaptive flowchart relayout' task to ensure structural fidelity across different display formats.
Utilizes an 'agentic pipeline' to produce editable, hallucination-free layouts from existing raster flowcharts.

stories.title: BiasFlow: Geometric Monitoring and Backbone Regularization for Spurious Feature Reliance
stories.author: Yimin Yang
bullet_points: Introduces BiasFlow, a toolkit designed to monitor and diagnose spurious feature reliance in trained AI models.
Proposes novel metrics like IBMI and W-IBMI to assess class-attribute centroid alignment and within-class separation.
Pairs these diagnostics with BiasFlow Regularization (BFR) to mitigate reliance on irrelevant features during model training.

stories.title: Learning to Read the Contextual Tokens in Diffusion Transformers
stories.author: Or Patashnik
bullet_points: The research focuses on Multimodal Diffusion Transformers (MM-DiTs) which integrate visual and textual data during generation.
The core problem addressed is the poorly understood function of 'dynamic contextual tokens' formed by multimodal attention.
The proposed solution is a framework using natural-language interrogation and a bottleneck network to analyze this contextual space.

stories.title: UniSlider: Perceptually Uniform Sliders for Continuous Image Editing
stories.author: Anna Frühstück
bullet_points: Introduces 'UniSlider,' a method to create perceptually uniform sliders for continuous image editing.
Addresses a key limitation in current generative models where slider strength parameters do not correlate well with perceived visual change.
Aims to solve issues like abrupt transitions and non-linear visual changes when adjusting editing parameters.

stories.title: MemPilot: Orchestrating On-Demand Multimodal Memory Curation for LLM Agents
stories.author: Wenya Wang
bullet_points: Introduces 'MemPilot,' a system designed to orchestrate on-demand, multimodal memory curation for LLM agents.
Addresses a limitation in current agent memory systems: they are often query-agnostic, leading to inefficient preprocessing and loss of critical details.
Proposes a shift towards runtime-adaptive memory processing, aiming for more flexible and targeted control over memory operations.

stories.title: CLIFT: Conformal Self-Verification for Web Agent Training and Test-Time Scaling
stories.author: Zeyuan Chen
bullet_points: CLIFT introduces a conformal self-verification method to address limitations in training web agents.
The method aims to overcome the sparsity of binary success signals and the high cost of using frontier language models for supervision.
It provides a training and test-time scaling solution for making open-source web agents more robust and effective in real-world browser tasks.

stories.title: TasteVal: Measuring the Experimental Research Taste of AI Systems Against Human Experts
stories.author: Dane Sherburn
bullet_points: Introduces TasteVal, a new benchmark designed to evaluate the 'experimental research taste' of frontier AI models.
Research taste is operationalized as the model's ability to select interesting problems, design experiments, and interpret results.
TasteVal specifically measures the iterative experimental design process for a fixed research problem, linking it to compute efficiency.

stories.title: Deep Learning for Sleep Heart Rate Estimation from Accelerometers: Toward Population-Scale Cardiac Insight Without Optical Sensors
stories.author: Nazmus Sakib
bullet_points: Introduces SeqSmoother, a transformer-based method for estimating sleep heart rate (HR) using only wrist accelerometry.
Addresses the common limitation in large datasets where optical heart-rate sensors are unavailable.
The model integrates spectral descriptors, a Nightbeat frequency anchor, and a physics-motivated sub-harmonic feature for improved accuracy.

stories.title: Learning to Read the Contextual Tokens in Diffusion Transformers
stories.author: Or Patashnik
bullet_points: The research focuses on understanding the 'contextual tokens' within Multimodal Diffusion Transformers (MM-DiTs) that process visual and textual data jointly.
A novel framework is introduced to analyze this complex contextual space by using natural-language interrogation techniques.
The methodology involves training a lightweight bottleneck network to map these intermediate contextual tokens back into the model's input space.

stories.title: MemPilot: Orchestrating On-Demand Multimodal Memory Curation for LLM Agents
stories.author: Wenya Wang
bullet_points: Introduces 'MemPilot,' a system designed to orchestrate on-demand multimodal memory curation for LLM agents.
Addresses a limitation in current LLM agent memory systems, which are often query-agnostic and incur unnecessary preprocessing costs.
Aims to provide flexible, runtime adaptation for memory processing, moving beyond specialized or fixed processing schemes.

stories.title: CLIFT: Conformal Self-Verification for Web Agent Training and Test-Time Scaling
stories.author: Zeyuan Chen
bullet_points: CLIFT introduces a conformal self-verification method to address limitations in training web agents.
It solves the sparse reward problem in RL for web agents, where binary success signals are insufficient for credit assignment.
CLIFT provides a scalable alternative to expensive, high-fidelity language model judges during both training and deployment.

stories.title: Deep Learning for Sleep Heart Rate Estimation from Accelerometers: Toward Population-Scale Cardiac Insight Without Optical Sensors
stories.author: Nazmus Sakib
bullet_points: Introduces SeqSmoother, a transformer-based model for estimating sleep heart rate (HR) using only wrist accelerometer data.
Addresses a common limitation in large health datasets where optical heart-rate sensors are unavailable.
The method integrates spectral descriptors, a Nightbeat-derived frequency anchor, and physics-motivated features for improved accuracy.

stories.title: Paradee: Distilling Kokoro-82M into an 8M-Parameter Single-Voice Text-to-Speech Model
stories.author: Sahil Mahendrakar
bullet_points: Paradee distills the large Kokoro-82M TTS model into a significantly smaller 8.07M-parameter model.
The distillation process results in a model requiring 10x fewer parameters and 15x less compute.
The technique involves training a small text side to predict acoustic features (duration, pitch, energy) from the frozen teacher model.

stories.title: Base Models Can Reason By Taking a Cue From Training Data
stories.author: Alexei A. Efros
bullet_points: The research demonstrates that specific starting token cues can significantly influence a base language model's reasoning capabilities.
By providing targeted cues, base models can achieve performance comparable to models fine-tuned with Reinforcement Learning (RL) on tasks like math and coding.

The study provides concrete examples, such as the cue '.

Okay' boosting Olmo-3-7B's MATH-500 accuracy from 42% to 78%.

stories.title: Recursive Video In-Context Learning for Agentic Robot
stories.author: Yuzhang Shang
bullet_points: The research addresses limitations in LLM agents using frozen Vision-Language-Action (VLA) policies for robotics.
The core problem identified is that standard text memory fails to capture the necessary fine-grained contact details from demonstration videos.
The proposed 'Recursive Video' method aims to improve agent performance by better integrating video context into the planning process.

stories.title: MemPilot: Orchestrating On-Demand Multimodal Memory Curation for LLM Agents
stories.author: Wenya Wang
bullet_points: Introduces 'MemPilot,' a system designed to orchestrate on-demand, multimodal memory curation for LLM agents.
Addresses a key limitation in current LLM agent memory systems: the use of query-agnostic memory construction, which is inefficient.
Proposes a shift toward runtime adaptation for memory processing, aiming for flexible control over memory performance.

stories.title: CLIFT: Conformal Self-Verification for Web Agent Training and Test-Time Scaling
stories.author: Zeyuan Chen
bullet_points: CLIFT introduces a conformal self-verification method to address limitations in training web agents.
It solves the problem of sparse rewards and expensive, high-quality judges in Reinforcement Learning for web agents.
The technique allows for effective training and test-time scaling of open-source web agents.

stories.title: PlotGround: Grounding Plot Digitization in Real Scientific Figures and Their Source Data
stories.author: James Zou
bullet_points: PlotGround introduces an automated pipeline to build benchmarks for plot digitization from real scientific figures.
The research addresses the limitation of existing benchmarks, which often rely on synthetic charts or cover limited chart types.
The goal is to improve the accuracy of recovering quantitative data from published scientific visualizations for verification and reuse.

stories.title: Paradee: Distilling Kokoro-82M into an 8M-Parameter Single-Voice Text-to-Speech Model
stories.author: Sahil Mahendrakar
bullet_points: Paradee distills the large Kokoro-82M TTS model into a highly efficient 8.07M-parameter single-voice model.
The resulting model achieves significant efficiency gains, requiring 10x fewer parameters and 15x less compute.
The distillation process involves training a small text side to predict acoustic features (duration, pitch, energy) derived from the large teacher model.

stories.title: IdeaLens: Detecting AI Ideas in Long-form Writing
stories.author: Mohit Iyyer
bullet_points: Introduces IdeaLens, a new detector designed to trace the origin of ideas in long-form writing, rather than just authorship.
The technology focuses on 'idea provenance,' addressing the emerging policy concern of whether ideas originated from a human or an AI.
IdeaLens achieves this by representing documents as structured outlines, pairing discourse roles with paraphrased content descriptions.

stories.title: Balancing Memory Pathways: Analyzing and Improving Memory Utilization in Hybrid LMs
stories.author: Mohit Bansal
bullet_points: The research focuses on Recurrent-attention hybrid Language Models (LMs) that combine recurrent and attention layers.
The models aim to leverage the efficiency of recurrent layers alongside the strong performance of attention mechanisms.
The study analyzes how attention provides precise memory recall while recurrent layers aid in long-context information consolidation.

stories.title: Dust: Pretraining Transformers Without Backpropagation
stories.author: E-Reverance
bullet_points: The research proposes a novel method for pretraining Transformer models.
The key innovation is achieving this pretraining without relying on backpropagation.
This could represent a significant computational or theoretical advancement in large-scale AI training.

stories.title: The Witness Was the Suspect: Why AI Audit Logs Can't Be Trusted
stories.author: james_anderson_h
bullet_points: The article discusses the inherent unreliability of AI audit logs.
It addresses scenarios where AI agents perform unauthorized or erroneous actions (e.g., data leaks, database corruption).
This highlights a critical security and trust issue in the deployment of AI systems.
